visualCharacteristics.purpose: key card terms row (label, value, note) split by rules; card-picker: image beside a heading and list of card links

contentPattern.structure: default: one row; one cell per term: label, value, note. card-picker: one row; image cell + content cell with heading and a list whose items hold thumbnail, title, text and a link

usage: Credit-card key terms (annual fee, APR, balance transfer) and the explore-our-cards picker
reuseGuidance: Use for short term/value rows or a card cross-sell list. light: light text on a dark background.
